# Templates (17)

A template is a set of finished pages. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`; the pages land in `app/`, so use it in a new project or a clean folder, and read the `docs` note it prints.

- **template-atlas** (application): A dense, quiet six-page admin for an online store: a dashboard with a live date range, sortable orders with bulk actions, an order page with a refund flow, products, customers and settings.
- **template-auth-kit** (application): Seven auth pages in three switchable layouts (centered, split with art, frosted glass): sign in, sign up with a live password checklist, six-digit verification, forgot and reset password, team invite and a three-step onboarding.
- **template-docs** (specialty): A five-page documentation site: search-first landing, a guide with synced language tabs, filterable API reference, search with highlighted matches and a changelog, with ⌘K search in the header.
- **template-goods** (specialty): A five-page store with a bag that persists across pages: a collage home, a filterable shop, a product page with glaze and gallery pickers, a bag with a free-shipping meter and promo code, and a validated checkout.
- **template-launch** (marketing): A four-page product site assembled entirely from Ballmac blocks (Hero6, Stats1, Features5, Testimonials2, Cta3, Pricing2, Pricing3, Faq2, Changelog1, Contact1) in one palette, so any section can be swapped for another block.
- **template-ledger** (marketing): A five-page site for a Mac app: an interactive desktop hero, a menu-bar tour, a native-features bento, a device lineup, license-or-subscription pricing, a download page, release notes and support.
- **template-muse** (application): A calm, reading-first AI chat app in five pages: a chat with reasoning, sources, a document panel and a model picker, a new-chat screen, projects, a library of everything made, and settings.
- **template-northwind** (marketing): A warm, editorial five-page site for a B2B product: serif headlines on cream paper, an interactive product tour with numbered pins, case studies, pricing, an about page and a demo request form.
- **template-orbit** (marketing): A dark, four-page site for an AI agent platform: a hero that plays a live agent run, tools, an eval chart, traces, security, pricing with a usage calculator, a changelog and sign-in.
- **template-pocket** (specialty): A bold five-page landing site for a money app: a working app inside a phone frame, live feature demos (freeze a card, round-up calculator, bill splitting, currency conversion), pricing with a yearly switch, security and download.
- **template-podcast** (content): A warm five-page podcast site built on a new audio player: a home with a latest-episode hero and a mini player, an episodes archive, an episode page with chapters and a transcript that follows playback, hosts and subscribe.
- **template-portfolio** (content): A bold five-page portfolio: a huge intro with inline colour pills, a work grid that reveals each result on hover and focus, an about bento, a case study with a sticky fact sheet and contents list, writing and a uses page.
- **template-publication** (content): An editorial five-page magazine: a masthead between double rules, a lead story, an article with reading progress, drop cap and margin notes, section pages with sort and load more, author pages and an issues shelf with…
- **template-relay** (marketing): A paper-and-ink, terminal-flavoured site for a developer API: a live send console, the life of an event, a delivery map, language-synced docs, usage pricing and a status page.
- **template-studio** (content): A loud, typographic five-page agency site: giant wide headlines, a work reel whose poster follows the pointer, numbered services that open, a work index with grid or table, project pages and a brief form.
- **template-summit** (specialty): A five-page conference site under a sunrise ridgeline: a hero with a live countdown, a schedule you can star into an agenda with clash warnings, speakers with bios, tickets with a live total and promo code, and a venue guide.
- **template-workspace** (application): A five-app productivity suite in one shell: a Today page with agenda, tasks and a focus timer, plus a full mail client, week calendar, drag-and-drop board and settings.
